verdict.rationale: The evidence touches only the edges of this story. The fraud guide says Stripe runs automatic risk controls across Treasury and Issuing, and that the platform must build and operate its own controls for onboarding, money movement, returns and negative balances. That gives a rough Stripe-versus-platform split and something close to transaction monitoring. The prebuilt embedded components are said to reduce compliance reviews. Missing for 10: sanctions screening, alert and case-management tooling, SAR-filing support, the sponsor bank's role in the duty split, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of compliance tooling.
